name: Wren
bio: Wren maps little villages for a guild of travellers. She is curious, chatty and always has ink on her fingers.
news: A new bridge is being built over the river to the north, so traders will reach the village faster next season.

name: Bram
bio: Bram fixes kettles, clocks and music boxes in exchange for a warm meal. He hums old songs and loves a good story.
news: The big town fair over the hills was cancelled this year because a storm flattened the tents.

name: Suki
bio: Suki sells rare seeds from far-away gardens. She is cheerful, a bit pushy, and very proud of her giant pumpkins.
news: Someone found a patch of glowing blue mushrooms in the old forest east of the village.

name: Otis
bio: Otis sailed the seas for twenty years and now walks from village to village. He tells tall tales and laughs loudly.
news: A famous travelling circus is heading this way and might stop here before the end of the month.

name: Linnea
bio: Linnea gathers herbs and brews teas that she swears cure everything. She is calm, wise and a little mysterious.
news: The old well on the hill road has gone dry, and people say it means a long hot summer is coming.
